descriptionText: The product is a rare ACE Holo card from the Pokémon TCG set "Sv5k: Wild Force." The card features the character "Maximum Belt" with card number 066/071. It is in Japanese language and has a shiny Holo finish, making it a desirable collectible for fans of the game and collectors of rare cards. The card is hard to find and is sure to be a valuable addition to any Pokémon card collection.
